newsitem.title: USA: Merrill cuts paper/timber group, sees lower prices.
newsitem.headline: Merrill cuts paper/timber group, sees lower prices.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co said its paper and timber analyst Sherman Chao lowered his investment ratings for paper and timber stocks, citing pricing pressures on some products.
Merrill said Chao had forecast lower prices for market pulp linerboard and uncoated freesheet.

Chao observed that producer inventories are rising while price discounts are widening. Chao also noted the backdrop of a low inflation environment which the Federal Reserve is attempting to preserve with a monetary policy tightening expected later today.
With the Fed trying to keep inflation pressures from building, the U.S. economy is unlikely to accelerate, he said.
Merrill said Chao cut Weyerhaueser Co to a near-term neutral from a accumulate but retained the company's long-term accumulate rating.
Chao cut Georgia-Pacific Corp to a near-term accumulate from a near-term buy but kept the long-term rating a buy.
Willamette Industries Inc's near-term rating was cut to accumulate from term buy, but the company remains a long-term buy, Merrill said.
Merrill cut Boise Cascade Corp to a near-term neutral from a near-term accumulate but retained its rating on the company as a long-term accumulate.
Merrill said Chao cut Champion International Corp to a near-term neutral from a near-term accumulate. Chao kept Champion at a long-term accumulate.
Chao cut Union Camp Corp to a near-term neutral from a near-term accumulate but kept the company's long-term accumulate rating.
Stone Container Corp's near-term rating was cut to a neutral from a near-term accumulate. Its long-term rating was cut to accumulate from buy.
